label: FICTION. Invented requirements, data flows, design decisions and artifacts, written to exercise the instrument. Nothing here was observed anywhere.

data_flows.description: Student record extract from the student system to a reporting store
Build artifacts pushed from the pipeline to the deployment target
Diagnostic export pulled by a support engineer to a local workstation
Scheduled job reading configuration from the shared configuration service
Nightly copy of the reporting store to an analytics sandbox

requirements.statement: Identifiable records leaving the student system must be reduced to the fields the receiving purpose needs, and the reduction must be stated in the design.
change_history: v1 (fictional): required encryption in transit only.
v3 (fictional): required the reduction to be stated in the design record, not only performed. This is the change that makes a v2 trace stale rather than merely old.

requirements.statement: Artifacts promoted to a deployment target must be attributable to the build that produced them.
A design that moves identifiable records across a trust boundary must have a data-flow model and a recorded design review.
change_history: v2 (fictional): added the recorded design review.

requirements.statement: Scheduled jobs must read configuration through the shared service rather than embedding values.

design_decisions.summary: Reporting extract selects a fixed column list rather than the full record
Promotion copies the artifact and records the originating build identifier
Support diagnostic export runs against a filtered view
Scheduled job reads its connection settings at start-up
Reporting store retains the extract for the full academic year

evidence.statement: A published secure-design standard requires a data-flow model for any design crossing a trust boundary
The design record template, in use for this decision, contains a 'security requirements considered' section
Design record states the extract was reduced to a fixed column list, citing the requirement at v2
Data-flow model covering the student system to reporting store path
Design review recorded, reviewer named, requirement confirmed considered
Design record states the originating build identifier is carried with the artifact
A threat model covering the diagnostic export exists but names no design decision
A published policy requires scheduled jobs to use the shared configuration service
Change record for SEC-REQ-SYN-01 v2 to v3, adding the obligation to state the reduction in the design
